import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

D, d = 768, 64
heads = {}
for l in range(12):
    w = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.qkv.W"], dtype=np.float64)
    b = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.qkv.b"], dtype=np.float64)
    s = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"], dtype=np.float64)
    shift = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.shift"], dtype=np.float64)
    out = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.out.W"], dtype=np.float64)
    for h in range(12):
        sl = slice(h*d, (h+1)*d)
        Q = s[:, None] * w[:, sl]
        K = s[:, None] * w[:, 768+h*d:768+(h+1)*d]
        V = s[:, None] * w[:, 1536+h*d:1536+(h+1)*d]
        # These projections remove the constant residual direction algebraically.
        Q -= Q.mean(axis=0)
        K -= K.mean(axis=0)
        V -= V.mean(axis=0)
        O = out[sl, :].copy()
        O -= O.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        qb = shift @ w[:, sl] + b[sl]
        A, B = Q @ K.T, V @ O
        heads[l, h] = dict(Q=Q, K=K, V=V, O=O, A=A, B=B,
                          bias=qb @ K.T)

source = heads[4, 9]
B = source["B"]
bn = np.linalg.norm(B)
rows = []
for (l, h), z in heads.items():
    if l <= 4:
        continue
    A = z["A"]
    C = A @ B.T
    an, cn = np.linalg.norm(A), np.linalg.norm(C)
    tr = np.trace(C)
    sym = (C + C.T) / 2
    rq = np.linalg.qr(z["Q"], mode="reduced")[1]
    rv = np.linalg.qr(source["V"], mode="reduced")[1]
    small = rq @ (z["K"].T @ source["O"].T) @ rv.T
    sv = np.linalg.svd(small, compute_uv=False)
    rows.append((l, h, tr/(an*bn), tr, tr/cn, tr/sv.sum(),
                 np.linalg.norm(sym)/cn, sv[0]**2/(sv@sv),
                 np.trace(A)/an, np.linalg.norm(z["bias"])/an,
                 cn/an))
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[2], reverse=True)

print("Composition with 4.9; all quantities are weight-matrix statistics.")
print("head cosine trace trace/Frob trace/nuclear sym_fraction top_sv_energy "
      "direct_QK_trace bias/QK comp/QK")
for r in rows[:30]:
    print(f"{r[0]}.{r[1]:<2} " + " ".join(f"{v:9.4f}" for v in r[2:]))

print("\nStrongest earlier sources for the leading candidates, after centering:")
for l, h in [(5,1),(6,9),(5,11),(7,4),(7,5),(5,3),(5,2),(7,10),(8,4)]:
    A = heads[l,h]["A"]
    an = np.linalg.norm(A)
    vals = []
    for (pl, ph), p in heads.items():
        if pl < l:
            PB = p["B"]
            raw = np.sum(A * PB)
            vals.append((raw/(an*np.linalg.norm(PB)), raw, pl, ph))
    vals.sort(reverse=True)
    print(f"{l}.{h}: " + "; ".join(
        f"{pl}.{ph} cos={co:.4f} trace={raw:.2f}"
        for co, raw, pl, ph in vals[:8]))

print("\nLayer norm scale summaries (median, RMS, min, max):")
for l in range(12):
    s = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"])
    print(l, *[round(float(x),5) for x in
               (np.median(s), np.sqrt(np.mean(s*s)), s.min(), s.max())])
